anomaly_pro — SPC anomaly_eval op

• Data kinds: video × video → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.anomaly_pro(scores, masks, fpr_max=0.3) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import anomeval; anomeval.anomaly_pro(scores, masks, fpr_max=0.3), registry से लेना हो तो opsspc.get("anomaly_pro"))

• GPU: नहीं (केवल CPU reference implementation)

उपयोग

हर defect region के overlap (PRO) की curve और fpr_max तक उसका normalised area AUPRO (table)।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

Definition (Bergmann et al., CVPR 2020): at a threshold t, every 8-connected defect region C of every mask scores |{score >= t} ∩ C| / |C|; PRO(t) is the mean over all regions, so a small defect weighs as much as a large one. FPR(t) is the fraction of all good pixels with score >= t. The curve is evaluated exactly at every distinct score (sorted cumulative sums, no threshold grid), starts at (0, 0), is integrated by the trapezoid rule up to fpr_max (the customary 0.3; linear interpolation at the cut) and divided by fpr_max → aupro in [0, 1]. Returns aupro, fpr / pro (the curve up to the cut), n_regions, fpr_max.

Raises ValueError on empty / mismatched / non-finite input, non-binary masks, no defect region, no good pixel, or fpr_max outside (0, 1].
